CMake + Android NDK: -DANDROID_PLATFORM=android-21 -DANDROID_ABI=arm64-v8a -DANDROID_STL=c++_static -DANDROID_SUPPORT_FLEXIBLE_PAGE_SIZES=ON -DVIRGIN_LIBRARY=ON; use the NDK android.toolchain.cmake. Other supported ABIs: armeabi-v7a, x86_64, x86. Java wrapper source and consumer rules: android/library.
